STAFF PAGE BATCH 2 - five display refinements, commit 3f9c7b8. All non-money: no migration, no RPC, no money helper touched, and every figure was already being computed - only how it is shown changed. (1) Export CSV is Excel-friendly: a UTF-8 BOM built from String.fromCharCode(0xfeff) (never a literal - U+FEFF renders as nothing, so a literal is invisible in every editor) so Arabic driver names stop arriving as mojibake, plus a sep=, directive because Excel opens a .csv with the SYSTEM list separator - on a ';' locale every row lands in one cell. Traded on asymmetric failure cost: one stray first row in Numbers/Sheets is recoverable in seconds, a silently single-columned sheet is not. CRLF terminators; csvCell quotes a bare \r too. The assembled lines are named `lines`, NOT `rows` - `rows` is the component's own unfiltered row memo and shadowing it is how an export quietly starts ignoring the filter. (2) Month lens + Export CSV moved beside the sub-tabs VIA A PORTAL. Lifting monthKey into DriversClient was REJECTED: CommissionsTab's own header states the figure beside Pay and the monthKey handed to payCommission cannot diverge BECAUSE there is exactly one of that state, and a prop boundary is precisely what would break it. controlsHost decides WHERE they render, never WHETHER. The host node is useState, not useRef - a ref's .current fills during commit without re-rendering, so the first paint would read null and the portal would never mount. (3) On Duty is FOUR SEPARATE BARS, one per derived state, sharing ONE denominator (the whole roster). DO NOT MERGE THEM BACK INTO ONE. Batch 1 shipped a single stacked track; on a stacked track every segment is measured against its neighbours, so the eye reads which state is biggest and cannot read how much of the roster is idle without arithmetic. A state at 0 degenerates into an empty track instead of a segment that vanished and took its label with it. Colours stay PILL_TONE_CLS[DRIVER_STATE_TONE[s]], the table the pills read. (4) The staff leave tally moved INSIDE the card (the absolutely-positioned corner badge and its wrapper div.relative are gone) and states its basis on screen - 'since Jan 1', not only in the tooltip, because without it the reader guesses between a rolling twelve months, an entitlement balance and a calendar-year tally. Zero renders NOTHING. DERIVED LIVE from leave_periods every render via the pre-existing leaveDaysInYear - THERE MUST NEVER BE A SCHEDULED RESET: a cron zeroing a stored counter each January would DESTROY the prior year's record to produce a number this expression gets for free, and it reads 0 on 1 January on its own. (5) The Incidents and Licence KPIs name the drivers behind the figure. Incident names come from driver_incidents (the same rows the KPI counts, so mohammed 2 appears), grouped by driver with a count suffix - the KPI counts ROWS and the '(2)' is what keeps the list addable back up to the figure above it. Licence names are ordered soonest-first, the order the list is acted on. driverLabelById appends a 4-char id fragment ONLY where a name is ambiguous (two drivers are both 'Fahad 4'). Truncated at three with the remainder counted and the full list on hover - a KPI card is a fixed-height tile in a six-column row. Zero names render NOTHING, never 'None'. FLEET ROWS - NO role OVERRIDE ON THE <tr>, deliberately. role=link/button on a table row takes it out of the table's accessibility tree - its thirteen <td>s stop being cells of a row, so a screen-reader user loses column context on every truck. The click guard is a descendant check (closest on the event target), NOT stopPropagation on every control - the check lives in one place and covers controls that do not exist yet; stopPropagation has to be remembered on every new button and fails silently when forgotten.
